title: React + TypeScript Architecture: Feature Boundaries, State & Server Data
concept: Structure a React app so it stays correct as it grows: features with clear boundaries, typed props and UI state, one owner for every piece of state, effects with honest dependencies, and server data treated as a cache, each checked with tests on the logic behind the UI.
description: An intermediate course for developers who can already write React components and want them to survive the next feature. Every lesson starts from an incident on the CodeDev course catalog - a page that fetches forever, a filter that jumps back to the old category, a list that shows yesterday's data after an edit, a form that accepts what the API refuses - and fixes it with a decision you can verify: feature folders and an API layer, discriminated unions for loading, error, empty and success, reducers for search, filter and page, derived state instead of copies, controlled forms, effect dependencies and cleanup, stale closures, a typed API client, query keys and invalidation, and debounced search that cancels old requests. 12 lessons with True/False quizzes on real code and evidence, and TypeScript challenges graded by hidden tests.

learningOutcomes.text: Split a React app by feature into components, hooks and an API layer with typed props
Model loading, error, empty and success as a discriminated union so impossible UI states do not compile
Give every piece of state one owner: local, lifted, reduced or derived, and keep forms controlled
Write effects with honest dependencies and cleanup, without render loops or stale closures
Treat server data as a cache: typed requests, query keys, invalidation after mutations and cancelled stale requests

knownIssues: No React or Testing Library in the code runner: challenges test the logic as pure functions, reducers and a small hook runtime that copies React's dependency rules

lessons.title: How to split a React app by feature: components, hooks & an API layer
How to type UI state with discriminated unions: loading, error, empty & success
Filter, sort & paginate the catalog with pure functions
How to manage search, filters & page with a reducer
Derived state: compute it, don't copy it
Controlled forms & validation the types can check
How useEffect dependencies work, and when you don't need an effect
Find the render loop: an effect that fetches forever
Stale closures: when an effect keeps the old filter
A typed API layer: response types & errors as a union
Server state as a cache: query keys & invalidation after a mutation
Debounced search that cancels stale requests, tested with fake timers
